name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.29
body:
## 更新内容 / What's New（安卓 v0.1.29）

这一版修了打字时「用一会儿，歇一会儿」不计时的问题，设置页换了新样子，应用内限制里加了 QQ 频道。

**用一会儿，歇一会儿**
- 以前打字时弹出的输入法会被当成换了一个 App，连续使用的时间会从头算，一直在打字的话到点也不会让你歇。现在输入法不算换 App，打字的时间照常算进去。

**平板**
- 以前有的平板（比如联想 Y700）在涟漪里被当成手机，页面上写的是「这台手机」。现在按系统信息和整块屏幕的大小来判断，平板会显示成平板。

**设置页**
- 设置页改成分组的卡片。开关下面留一行说明，「等一会儿」的时长这类不好懂的项目旁边有问号，点开能看解释。
- 「等一会儿」的时长、提前多久出现倒计时和语言，改成点开后在弹层里选。
- 只改了样子，各项设置的作用都没变，已有的设置保持原样。

**应用内限制：QQ 频道**
- 新增「QQ · 频道」，排在「微信 · 小程序」下面。打开后，进 QQ 底部的「频道」、热门频道、子频道聊天或帖子会被拦下。QQ 单聊、群聊和联系人照常用。
- 可以选直接拦，也可以先给几分钟再拦。从「频道」页被拦时回到 QQ 消息页，从别的页面点进频道被拦时退回上一页。

**其他**
- 英文界面里「WeChat · Channels」和「WeChat · Moments」后面不再带中文括号。

**已知限制**
- QQ 频道在 OPPO 手机上测过底部「频道」入口和从联系人点进频道，都能拦下，聊天和群聊没有被误拦。热门频道、子频道聊天和帖子只用手机上采到的页面样本在测试里验证过。QQ 以后改版的话可能要跟着调整。
- 输入法的修复和平板判断在模拟器上验证过，还没在平板真机上试过。
- 这些改动只在安卓上有。iPhone 版没有更新，仍是 v0.1.5。

---

This release fixes Take a Break not counting time while you type, gives Settings a new look, and adds QQ Channels to in-app limits.

**Take a Break**
- The keyboard that pops up while you type used to count as switching to another app, so the time in a row started over. If you kept typing, the rest never came. The keyboard no longer counts as switching apps, and typing time is counted.

**Tablets**
- Some tablets, such as the Lenovo Y700, were treated as phones, and pages said "this phone". The app now checks the system info and the size of the whole screen, so a tablet shows as a tablet.

**Settings**
- Settings is now laid out in grouped cards. Switches keep a one line note, and items that are hard to read at a glance, such as the wait time, have a question mark you can tap for an explanation.
- Wait time, how early the countdown shows, and language are now picked from a sheet after you tap them.
- Only the look changed. Every setting works as before and keeps its current value.

**In-app limits: QQ Channels**
- New "QQ · Channels" item, placed under WeChat · Mini Programs. When it is on, opening the Channels tab at the bottom of QQ, Popular channels, a channel chat or a post gets blocked. QQ chats, groups and contacts still work.
- You can block right away or allow a few minutes first. When blocked on the Channels tab you go back to QQ Chats. When you open a channel from another page, you go back to that page.

**Other**
- In the English interface, "WeChat · Channels" and "WeChat · Moments" no longer have Chinese text in brackets.

**Known limits**
- On an OPPO phone, QQ Channels was tested from the Channels tab and from opening a channel in Contacts. Both were blocked, and chats and groups were not affected. Popular channels, channel chats and posts were only checked in tests with page samples taken from the phone. A future QQ update may need changes here.
- The keyboard fix and the tablet check were verified on an emulator, not yet on a real tablet.
- These changes are Android only. The iPhone app was not updated and remains v0.1.5.
